Out-of-credit fixtures for tools/reviewer_admission.py "credit" and the five
rotation wrappers and StepFun. Identifiers are replaced with zeros; message text is kept.

grok-xai-403.stderr        real xAI 403 text from the 2026-09-24 EDGE-DEV incident
deepseek-402.json          DeepSeek HTTP 402 "Insufficient Balance" body
gemini-prepay.json         Gemini "prepayment credits are depleted" in the agy JSON shape
qwen-arrearage.jsonl       DashScope Arrearage refusal as Qwen Code reports it ([API Error: ...])
muse-insufficient-quota.jsonl  OpenAI-compatible insufficient_quota in the Muse error-event shape
negative-rate-limit.txt    rate limits and a bare RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: must NOT classify
stepfun-402.txt            StepFun HTTP 402 quota_exceeded body as the StepCode CLI prints it
